channel_google_description: Sign in with Google on Kiro’s verification page to authorize this device.
channel_github_description: Sign in with GitHub on Kiro’s verification page to authorize this device.
channel_builder_id_description: Authorize this device with your personal AWS Builder ID.
channel_identity_center_description: Authorize this device through your organization’s AWS access portal.
start_url_description: Enter the URL of your organization’s AWS access portal, such as https://example.awsapps.com/start.
region_description: Enter the region code for your IAM Identity Center instance, such as us-east-1.
system_prompt_user_injection: Inject system prompt via user turn
system_prompt_user_injection_description: By default, instructions are injected as the first user message followed by an assistant acknowledgment, matching Kiro CLI 3.4.0 Custom Agent behavior without using the top-level systemPrompt field. Turn this off to send instructions in the top-level systemPrompt field.
